data.title: Living to 100 Means Building Health, Wealth and Bonds Early, Experts Say
data.description: Dr Narongchai Akrasanee and Benjaporn Karoonkornsakul urge Thais to build strong bodies, savings and friendships well before old age arrives

data.title: Gourmet Market and Gourmet Eats at Terminal 21 Asok unveil a new look
data.description: Gourmet Market, the world-class gourmet destination, and Gourmet Eats , a curated dining destination catering to every lifestyle under The Mall Group, have unveiled the newly transformed Terminal 21 Asok branch in Bangkok following its first major renovation in 15 years. Reimagined under the concept “Endless and Unlike Any Other Supermarket & Food Experience,” the destination evolves beyond a premium supermarket into a vibrant food and lifestyle hub in the heart of Sukhumvit, catering to modern urban consumers and international visitors seeking convenience, discovery and inspiration through food in a single destination.

data.title: North Korea releases Kim photos to counter death rumours
data.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has appeared in photographs released by state media during a visit to a clothing exhibition, as speculation about his health and rumoured death circulates online.

data.title: Rubio lands in India for ‘trade diplomacy’
data.description: MUMBAI - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in India on Tuesday, his second official visit to the country this year, as he pursues an Asian tour blending diplomacy and trade.

data.title: Boxer Somluck cleared of girl's rape, gets 2 years for lewd abduction
data.description: KHON KAEN - The Appeal Court on Tuesday cleared Olympic medallist boxer Somluck Kamsing of attempted rape, but sentenced him to two years in prison for abducting a minor for lewd purpose.

data.title: PTTEP wins Human Rights Role Model award for 3rd consecutive year
data.description: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited (PTTEP), represented by Mrs. Susama Pitakuldilog, Senior Vice-President of the Sustainability and Stakeholder Management Division, received the “Human Rights Role Model Organization” award for 2026 at the Top-Tier Gold level (highest level), in the State Enterprise category. The accolade was presented by Police Lieutenant General Rutthaphon Naowarat, Minister of Justice, at the Human Rights Awards 2026 ceremony organized by the Rights and Liberties Protection Department, Ministry of Justice. PTTEP has received the Human Rights Role Model Organization award for eight consecutive years, achieving the Top-Tier Gold level for the third consecutive year.

data.title: Empowering Tomorrow: Bosch Crowns Winners of INNOVISION YOUNG GEN 2026
data.description: Nationwide Youth Engagement: Nearly 400 high school and university applicants submitted UN SDG-aligned concepts, with 40 shortlisted finalists completing an intensive systems-thinking and sensor-based technology workshop.

data.title: Betagro Acquires a Majority Stake in Freshket, Thailand’s Leading Digital Food Supply Platform
data.description: Bangkok – October 20, 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (SET: BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, today announced that it has acquired a majority stake in Freshket, Thailand’s leading digital food supply platform for the hotel, restaurant and catering (HORECA) sector. The investment was made through Betagro Ventures. Financial terms were not disclosed.

data.title: ‘Real’ Chinese tourists won’t face kidnap risk, says minister
data.description: Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul has responded to a new Chinese travel advisory about the risk of kidnapping in Thailand, saying genuine tourists would never be targeted by criminal gangs.

data.title: Caltex invests over 500 million baht in seamless digitalisation
data.description: Caltex officially launches “ Kebdao”, a new loyalty platform designed to connect customer experiences at every touchpoint, from re-fueling and non-oil services to rewards and exclusive offers through a digital platform. As part of its long-term strategy, Caltex has allocated over 500 million baht for seamless digitalisation & Infrastructure upgrade project from 2026 to 2030, covering digital backbone development, a complete overhaul of its digital network infrastructure, and loyalty program management. This investment will, on one hand, lay the foundation for the new loyalty platform and on the other, support the expansion of services and its long-term loyalty ecosystem. Caltex aims to double its “Kebdao” membership base to 1.5 million within 2030.

data.title: Settler violence becomes a liability for Israeli PM
data.description: JERUSALEM - Attacks on a US journalist and European diplomats in the occupied West Bank have turned Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s championing of settlers into a potential liability days before elections, with opponents calling him soft on “Jewish terrorism”.

data.title: Bangkok Post wins travel media award
data.description: The Bangkok Post has won the Travel Section of the Year award at this year's TravMedia Awards Asia, recognising its travel journalism and commitment to delivering reliable, informative and engaging stories about destinations across the region.

data.title: Investigators question MP’s husband about gambling site shares
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband met with Department of Special Investigation (DSI) investigators on Tuesday to provide information about his shareholding in the online gambling website Shuffle.com.

data.title: IMF-World Bank meeting explores how creative IP can boost Thai content globally
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organisation) or CEA, hosted “CREATIVITY AS CAPITAL: Driving the Next Growth Frontier” as an official Affiliated Programme of the 2026 IMF–World Bank Group Annual Meetings. The programme featured a forum titled “From Creative Capital to Global Asset,” that brought together perspectives from international executives and leading creative content industry figures on how creative intellectual property (IP) can evolve from creative works into high-value assets capable of attracting investment, generating economic value and enabling businesses to scale into global markets.

data.title: France to impose new curfews where necessary: PM
data.description: PARIS — France will impose new curfews in areas where needed on Tuesday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said, adding that the measures introduced in several cities the previous day had "helped keep the night calm".

data.title: Indonesia investigates crash of suspected Chinese rocket fragment
data.description: JAKARTA — Indonesian authorities were investigating on Tuesday after a car-sized piece of what a government agency said was a Chinese space rocket crashed into a palm oil plantation near homes and work sites.

data.title: Justice minister details progress in MP Suchada's gambling website case
data.description: Justice Minister Rutthapon Naowarat has denied suggestions he was attempting to whitewash Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband over their suspected links to an online gambling network.

data.title: Chinese students ripped off by condo agents
data.description: A group of Chinese students on Tuesday filed a police complaint against a condominium agent they had paid about 10 million baht to arrange rented accommodation, but had failed to do so.

data.title: ‘Online echo chamber’ amplifies political violence threats in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia’s security chiefs had warned of “online echo chambers” fuelling grievances and conspiracies and stepped up prosecutions for threats of political violence ahead of Monday’s attack on a lawmaker in a rural town.

data.title: South Korea to reduce Ukraine embassy staff after PoW row
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's foreign ministry said on Tuesday it would withdraw some staff from its embassy in Ukraine, as a diplomatic row deepens over the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul.

data.title: Bangkok council seeks cable solutions
data.description: Bangkok councillors have approved a special committee to study solutions for disorganised communication cables, including relocating them underground on suitable roads, with a 90-day deadline for its review.

data.title: Seoul warns of ‘firm’ response to North Korea’s border threats
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea’s military warned Tuesday of a “firm” response and resolute punishment for any further provocations by North Korea, saying it was “unacceptable” for Pyongyang to blame Seoul for escalating tensions.

data.title: City Hall extends flood aid registration period as delays mount
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has extended the deadline for flood victims to file the paperwork needed for financial assistance for another month, until the end of November.

data.title: Too much of a good scent? Hanoi trims iconic trees
data.description: HANOI - Vietnam's capital Hanoi has launched a large-scale programme to prune hundreds of its iconic blackboard trees and is considering relocating some after their distinctive fragrance proved too much for some residents.

data.title: Five tonnes of cannabis buds seized in Bangkok
data.description: Police have arrested four Myanmar workers and their Vietnamese boss and seized five tonnes of cannabis buds at a rented house in Bangkok, and caught five Thais on a central plains highway with 284 kilogrammes of crystal meth.

data.title: Luke Evans brings his 'BDXY' to The Standard, Hua Hin
data.description: You may already know Luke Evans as a Welsh actor and singer, but he has also forayed into fashion by launching BDXY, the UK-born fashion and resort-wear brand, with his co-founder and partner Fran Tomas in February 2024.
